assertions.assertion: AddOperationalStore options set EnableTokenCleanup to false
assertions.rationale: The web-node snippet sets o.EnableTokenCleanup = false in AddOperationalStore.

assertions.assertion: A class inheriting from BackgroundService (or IHostedService) is created named TokenCleanupWorker or similar
The worker class injects or resolves TokenCleanupService from Duende.IdentityServer.EntityFramework
assertions.rationale: Resolves TokenCleanupService via scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<TokenCleanupService>() from an injected IServiceScopeFactory.

assertions.assertion: The ExecuteAsync method calls CleanupGrantsAsync() in a while loop that respects the CancellationToken
assertions.rationale: ExecuteAsync runs a do { ... } while (await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(ct)) loop and calls cleanup.CleanupGrantsAsync(ct); the loop is bound to the CancellationToken.

assertions.assertion: The delay between cleanup runs is 2 hours (TimeSpan.FromHours(2) or equivalent)
